1→## My dotfiles
     2→
     3→A set of tools and environment setups I require for work.
     4→
     5→This repo should be cloned into `~/Developer/dotfiles` for it to correctly link everything.
     6→
     7→## Installation
     8→
     9→To run the full installation:
    10→
    11→```bash
    12→make install
    13→```
    14→
    15→Or manually run:
    16→
    17→```bash
    18→sh bootstrap.sh
    19→```
    20→
    21→## Available Commands
    22→
    23→```bash
    24→make install  # Run full installation
    25→make update   # Update symlinks only
    26→make backup   # Backup existing configs
    27→make ssh      # Setup SSH keys and config
    28→make clean    # Remove symlinks
    29→make help     # Show available commands
    30→```
    31→
    32→## What Gets Installed
    33→
    34→The installation script will:
    35→
    36→### 1. Install Xcode Command Line Tools
    37→Required for development tools and compilers.
    38→
    39→### 2. Configure macOS Preferences
    40→Custom system preferences via `osx/osx.sh`.
    41→
    42→### 3. Install Homebrew & Applications
    43→The following applications are installed via Homebrew:
    44→
    45→**CLI Tools:**
    46→* zsh
    47→
    48→**Applications:**
    49→* Alfred
    50→* Hammerspoon
    51→* Stats
    52→* Firefox
    53→* Ghostty
    54→* Proxyman
    55→* RapidAPI
    56→* Sourcetree
    57→* Spotify
    58→* Visual Studio Code
    59→* Xcodes
    60→
    61→### 4. Setup Zsh
    62→* Installs Oh My Zsh
    63→* Configures Powerlevel10k theme
    64→* Symlinks `.zshrc` and `.p10k.zsh` to home directory
    65→
    66→### 5. Setup Git
    67→* Symlinks `.gitconfig` and `.gitignore_global` to home directory
    68→* Configures global Git settings
    69→
    70→### 6. Setup SSH
    71→* Creates SSH directory structure
    72→* Optionally generates SSH keys for Git
    73→* Symlinks SSH config
    74→
    75→### 7. Setup Ghostty
    76→* Creates Ghostty config directory
    77→* Symlinks Ghostty configuration to `~/.config/ghostty/config`
    78→
    79→### 8. Setup Hammerspoon
    80→* Creates Hammerspoon config directory
    81→* Symlinks Hammerspoon configuration to `~/.hammerspoon/`
    82→* Configures window management, focus modes, and custom shortcuts
    83→
    84→## Manual Steps
    85→
    86→After installation completes, perform these additional steps:
    87→
    88→### SSH Keys
    89→
    90→1. If you didn't create an SSH key during installation, run:
    91→   ```bash
    92→   make ssh
    93→   ```
    94→
    95→2. Add the public key to your Git providers:
    96→   - **GitHub:** https://github.com/settings/keys
    97→   - **GitLab:** https://gitlab.com/-/profile/keys
    98→
    99→   Your public key is displayed at the end of `make ssh`, or run:
   100→   ```bash
   101→   cat ~/.ssh/id_git.pub
   102→   ```
   103→
   104→### Xcode
   105→
   106→Install full Xcode via Xcodes.app (installed via Homebrew):
   107→```bash
   108→open -a Xcodes
   109→```
   110→
   111→### Application Settings
   112→
   113→#### Ghostty
   114→1. Open Ghostty
   115→2. Configuration is automatically loaded from `~/.config/ghostty/config`
   116→3. Font and theme settings are pre-configured
   117→
   118→#### Hammerspoon
   119→1. Open Hammerspoon
   120→2. Configuration is automatically loaded from `~/.hammerspoon/`
   121→3. Window management shortcuts and focus modes are pre-configured
   122→4. Grant Accessibility permissions when prompted
   123→
   124→#### Zsh/Powerlevel10k
   125→If you need to reconfigure the prompt:
   126→```bash
   127→p10k configure
   128→```
   129→
   130→## Troubleshooting
   131→
   132→### Symlinks not working
   133→Run `make update` to recreate symlinks
   134→
   135→### Restore from backup
   136→Backups are stored with timestamps (e.g., `~/.zshrc.backup.20250108_123456`)
   137→```bash
   138→cp ~/.zshrc.backup.YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS ~/.zshrc
   139→```
   140→
   141→### Clean install
   142→To remove all symlinks and start fresh:
   143→```bash
   144→make clean
   145→make install
   146→```
   147→

1→.PHONY: install update backup clean help ssh
     2→
     3→help:
     4→	@echo "╔═══════════════════════════════════╗"
     5→	@echo "║  📚 Dotfiles Management Help      ║"
     6→	@echo "╚═══════════════════════════════════╝"
     7→	@echo ""
     8→	@echo "🚀 make install  - Run full installation"
     9→	@echo "🔄 make update   - Update symlinks only"
    10→	@echo "💾 make backup   - Backup existing configs"
    11→	@echo "🔐 make ssh      - Setup SSH keys and config"
    12→	@echo "🧹 make clean    - Remove symlinks"
    13→	@echo "❓ make help     - Show this help"
    14→	@echo ""
    15→
    16→install:
    17→	@echo "🚀 Starting full installation...\n"
    18→	@sh bootstrap.sh
    19→
    20→update:
    21→	@echo "🔄 Updating symlinks..."
    22→	@sh git/git.sh
    23→	@sh zsh/zsh.sh
    24→	@sh ghostty/ghostty.sh
    25→	@sh hammerspoon/hammerspoon.sh
    26→	@echo "✅ Symlinks updated!\n"
    27→
    28→backup:
    29→	@echo "💾 Backing up existing configs..."
    30→	@[ -f ~/.zshrc ] && cp ~/.zshrc ~/.zshrc.backup.$$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S) && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.zshrc" || true
    31→	@[ -f ~/.gitconfig ] && cp ~/.gitconfig ~/.gitconfig.backup.$$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S) && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.gitconfig" || true
    32→	@[ -f ~/.p10k.zsh ] && cp ~/.p10k.zsh ~/.p10k.zsh.backup.$$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S) && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.p10k.zsh" || true
    33→	@[ -f ~/.gitignore_global ] && cp ~/.gitignore_global ~/.gitignore_global.backup.$$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S) && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.gitignore_global" || true
    34→	@echo "✅ Backups created with timestamp!\n"
    35→
    36→ssh:
    37→	@echo "🔐 Setting up SSH..."
    38→	@sh ssh/ssh.sh
    39→
    40→clean:

1→# Hammerspoon Configuration
     2→
     3→This is a modular Hammerspoon configuration for macOS automation and window management.
     4→
     5→## Structure
     6→
     7→```
     8→~/.hammerspoon/
     9→├── init.lua                    # Main configuration file
    10→├── modules/                    # Modular functionality
    11→│   ├── app-toggle.lua         # Application toggle module
    12→│   ├── media-controls.lua     # Media control module
    13→│   └── window-management.lua  # Window positioning module
    14→└── README.md                  # This file
    15→```
    16→
    17→## Features
    18→
    19→### Application Toggle
    20→
    21→Toggle applications with a single hotkey. If the app isn't running, it launches. If it's focused, it hides. If it's running but not focused, it brings it to front.
    22→
    23→**Current bindings:**
    24→- `Cmd+Space` - Toggle Ghostty terminal
    25→
    26→### Window Management
    27→
    28→Quickly position and resize windows using keyboard shortcuts.
    29→
    30→**Window positioning hotkeys:**
    31→- `Cmd+Option+Left Arrow` - Move window to left half of screen
    32→- `Cmd+Option+Right Arrow` - Move window to right half of screen
    33→- `Cmd+Option+Up Arrow` - Maximize window to full screen
    34→- `Cmd+Option+Down Arrow` - Center window on screen (70% of screen size)
    35→
    36→**Quarter-screen positioning hotkeys:**
    37→- `Cmd+Option+U` - Move window to top-left quarter
    38→- `Cmd+Option+I` - Move window to top-right quarter
    39→- `Cmd+Option+N` - Move window to bottom-left quarter
    40→- `Cmd+Option+M` - Move window to bottom-right quarter
    41→
    42→**Vim-style window focus navigation:**
    43→- `Cmd+Option+K` - Focus window to the left
    44→- `Cmd+Option+O` - Focus window above
    45→- `Cmd+Option+L` - Focus window below
    46→- `Cmd+Option+Ö` - Focus window to the right
    47→
    48→**Window swapping:**
    49→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+K` - Swap focused window with left neighbor
    50→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+O` - Swap focused window with above neighbor
    51→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+L` - Swap focused window with below neighbor
    52→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+Ö` - Swap focused window with right neighbor
    53→
    54→**Multi-display hotkeys:**
    55→- `Cmd+Option+Ctrl+Left Arrow` - Move window to left display
    56→- `Cmd+Option+Ctrl+Right Arrow` - Move window to right display
    57→
    58→### Media Controls
    59→
    60→Control system volume using mouse buttons.
    61→
    62→**Volume control:**
    63→- `Mouse Button 4` (side button) - Increase volume by 5%
    64→- `Mouse Button 5` (side button) - Decrease volume by 5%
    65→
    66→### Configuration Reload
    67→
    68→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+R` - Reload Hammerspoon configuration
    69→
    70→## Usage
    71→
    72→### Adding Application Hotkeys
    73→
    74→To add a new application hotkey, edit `init.lua` and add a line under the "Application Hotkeys" section:
    75→
    76→```lua
    77→appToggle.bindToggle({"cmd", "shift"}, "b", "Safari")
    78→```
    79→
    80→This binds `Cmd+Shift+B` to toggle Safari.
    81→
    82→### Adding Custom Modules
    83→
    84→1. Create a new `.lua` file in the `modules/` directory
    85→2. Define your module as a table with functions
    86→3. Return the module table at the end of the file
    87→4. Load it in `init.lua` with `require("modules.your-module")`
    88→
    89→Example module structure:
    90→
    91→```lua
    92→-- modules/example.lua
    93→local M = {}
    94→
    95→function M.someFunction()
    96→    -- Your code here
    97→end
    98→
    99→return M
   100→```
   101→
   102→Then in `init.lua`:
   103→
   104→```lua
   105→local example = require("modules.example")
   106→example.someFunction()
   107→```
   108→
   109→## Modules
   110→
   111→### app-toggle.lua
   112→
   113→Provides functionality to toggle application visibility.
   114→
   115→**Functions:**
   116→- `createToggle(appName)` - Creates a toggle function for an application
   117→- `bindToggle(modifiers, key, appName)` - Binds a hotkey to toggle an application
   118→
   119→**Example:**
   120→
   121→```lua
   122→local appToggle = require("modules.app-toggle")
   123→
   124→-- Create a toggle function
   125→local toggleSafari = appToggle.createToggle("Safari")
   126→
   127→-- Or bind directly to a hotkey
   128→appToggle.bindToggle({"cmd", "shift"}, "b", "Safari")
   129→```
   130→
   131→### window-management.lua
   132→
   133→Provides window positioning, resizing, and focus navigation functionality.
   134→
   135→**Functions:**
   136→- `moveToLeft()` - Moves focused window to left half of screen
   137→- `moveToRight()` - Moves focused window to right half of screen
   138→- `maximize()` - Maximizes focused window to full screen
   139→- `center()` - Centers focused window at 70% screen size
   140→- `moveToTopLeft()` - Moves focused window to top-left quarter of screen
   141→- `moveToTopRight()` - Moves focused window to top-right quarter of screen
   142→- `moveToBottomLeft()` - Moves focused window to bottom-left quarter of screen
   143→- `moveToBottomRight()` - Moves focused window to bottom-right quarter of screen
   144→- `focusWindowLeft()` - Focuses the window to the left
   145→- `focusWindowDown()` - Focuses the window below
   146→- `focusWindowUp()` - Focuses the window above
   147→- `focusWindowRight()` - Focuses the window to the right
   148→- `swapWindowLeft()` - Swaps focused window with left neighbor
   149→- `swapWindowDown()` - Swaps focused window with below neighbor
   150→- `swapWindowUp()` - Swaps focused window with above neighbor
   151→- `swapWindowRight()` - Swaps focused window with right neighbor
   152→- `moveToLeftDisplay()` - Moves focused window to the display on the left (west)
   153→- `moveToRightDisplay()` - Moves focused window to the display on the right (east)
   154→- `bindHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds all window management functions to arrow keys
   155→- `bindQuarterScreenHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds quarter-screen positioning to U/I/N/M keys
   156→- `bindVimFocusHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds Vim-style focus navigation to K/O/L/Ö keys
   157→- `bindWindowSwapHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds window swapping to K/O/L/Ö keys
   158→- `bindMultiDisplayHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds multi-display functions to arrow keys
   159→
   160→**Example:**
   161→
   162→```lua
   163→local windowMgmt = require("modules.window-management")
   164→
   165→-- Bind all hotkeys with Cmd+Option
   166→windowMgmt.bindHotkeys({"cmd", "alt"})
   167→
   168→-- Bind quarter-screen hotkeys with Cmd+Option
   169→windowMgmt.bindQuarterScreenHotkeys({"cmd", "alt"})
   170→
   171→-- Bind Vim-style focus navigation with Cmd+Option (K/O/L/Ö)
   172→windowMgmt.bindVimFocusHotkeys({"cmd", "alt"})
   173→
   174→-- Bind window swapping with Cmd+Option+Shift (K/O/L/Ö)
   175→windowMgmt.bindWindowSwapHotkeys({"cmd", "alt", "shift"})
   176→
   177→-- Bind multi-display hotkeys with Cmd+Option+Ctrl
   178→windowMgmt.bindMultiDisplayHotkeys({"cmd", "alt", "ctrl"})
   179→
   180→-- Or call individual functions
   181→windowMgmt.moveToLeft()
   182→windowMgmt.maximize()
   183→windowMgmt.moveToTopLeft()
   184→windowMgmt.focusWindowRight()
   185→windowMgmt.swapWindowLeft()
   186→windowMgmt.moveToLeftDisplay()
   187→```
   188→
   189→### media-controls.lua
   190→
   191→Provides media control functionality including volume control.
   192→
   193→**Functions:**
   194→- `volumeUp()` - Increases system volume by 5%
   195→- `volumeDown()` - Decreases system volume by 5%
   196→- `bindMouseButtons()` - Binds mouse buttons 4 and 5 to volume controls
   197→
   198→**Example:**
   199→
   200→```lua
   201→local mediaControls = require("modules.media-controls")
   202→
   203→-- Bind mouse buttons to volume controls
   204→mediaControls.bindMouseButtons()
   205→
   206→-- Or call volume functions directly
   207→mediaControls.volumeUp()
   208→mediaControls.volumeDown()
   209→```

1→# Hammerspoon Feature Roadmap
     2→
     3→Inspired by [Rift window manager](https://github.com/acsandmann/rift), this document outlines useful features to adapt for our Hammerspoon window management workflow.
     4→
     5→## High Priority - Easy Wins
     6→
     7→### 1. Quarter-Screen Positioning ✅ Implemented
     8→Add top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right window positioning.
     9→
    10→**Keybindings:**
    11→- `Cmd+Opt+U` - Top-left quarter
    12→- `Cmd+Opt+I` - Top-right quarter
    13→- `Cmd+Opt+N` - Bottom-left quarter
    14→- `Cmd+Opt+M` - Bottom-right quarter
    15→
    16→**Status:** ✅ Implemented
    17→
    18→### 2. Vim-style Window Focus Navigation ✅ Implemented
    19→Navigate between windows using directional keys.
    20→
    21→**Keybindings:**
    22→- `Cmd+Opt+K` - Focus window to the left
    23→- `Cmd+Opt+O` - Focus window above
    24→- `Cmd+Opt+L` - Focus window below
    25→- `Cmd+Opt+Ö` - Focus window to the right
    26→
    27→**Status:** ✅ Implemented
    28→
    29→### 3. Window Swapping ✅ Implemented
    30→Move windows between positions without resizing.
    31→
    32→**Keybindings:**
    33→- `Cmd+Opt+Shift+K` - Swap focused window with left neighbor
    34→- `Cmd+Opt+Shift+O` - Swap focused window with above neighbor
    35→- `Cmd+Opt+Shift+L` - Swap focused window with below neighbor
    36→- `Cmd+Opt+Shift+Ö` - Swap focused window with right neighbor
    37→
    38→**Status:** ✅ Implemented
    39→
    40→### 4. Floating Window Toggle
    41→Mark specific windows to ignore tiling and keep them always accessible.
    42→
    43→**Proposed Keybindings:**
    44→- `Cmd+Opt+F` - Toggle floating mode for focused window
    45→
    46→**Status:** Not implemented
    47→
    48→## Medium Priority - Useful Additions
    49→
    50→### 5. Window Stack/Unstack
    51→Tab multiple windows together in the same space and cycle through them.
    52→
    53→**Features:**
    54→- Stack windows on top of each other
    55→- Cycle through stacked windows
    56→- Reduces screen clutter
    57→
    58→**Status:** Not implemented
    59→
    60→### 6. Focus Follows Mouse (Optional)
    61→Auto-focus window when hovering over it.
    62→
    63→**Features:**
    64→- Toggleable on/off
    65→- Optional auto-raise
    66→- Configurable delay
    67→
    68→**Status:** Not implemented
    69→
    70→### 7. Per-Display Workspace Memory
    71→Remember which workspace/layout each display is on.
    72→
    73→**Features:**
    74→- Smoother multi-display workflow
    75→- Preserve window arrangements per display
    76→- Restore layouts on reconnect
    77→
    78→**Status:** Not implemented
    79→
    80→## Low Priority - Nice to Have
    81→
    82→### 8. Animation Customization
    83→Enhance existing animation system with more options.
    84→
    85→**Features:**
    86→- Configurable easing curves (ease-in, ease-out, linear, etc.)
    87→- Adjustable duration (currently 0.2s)
    88→- FPS control for smoother/faster animations
    89→
    90→**Status:** Not implemented (basic duration control exists)
    91→
    92→### 9. App-Specific Rules
    93→Define behavior rules for specific applications.
    94→
    95→**Features:**
    96→- Auto-float certain apps (e.g., System Preferences, Calculator)
    97→- Auto-position apps to specific screens/positions
    98→- Launch apps in specific layouts
    99→- Exclude apps from window management
   100→
   101→**Status:** Not implemented
   102→
   103→## Implementation Notes
   104→
   105→### Current Setup
   106→- Window animations: 0.2s duration
   107→- Window management: left/right half, maximize, center
   108→- Quarter-screen positioning: U/I/N/M keys ✅
   109→- Window focus navigation: K/O/L/Ö keys ✅
   110→- Window swapping: Shift+K/O/L/Ö keys ✅
   111→- Multi-display: move window left/right between displays
   112→- App toggle: Ghostty terminal with `Cmd+Space`
   113→- Media controls: Mouse buttons 4/5 for volume
   114→
   115→### Compatibility Considerations
   116→- Maintain existing keybindings where possible
   117→- Avoid conflicts with macOS system shortcuts
   118→- Ensure new features work with multi-display setups
   119→- Keep modular structure for easy maintenance
   120→
   121→## References
   122→
   123→- [Rift Window Manager](https://github.com/acsandmann/rift) - Primary inspiration
   124→- [Hammerspoon API Documentation](https://www.hammerspoon.org/docs/)
   125→- [i3 Window Manager](https://i3wm.org/) - Tiling concepts
   126→- [bspwm](https://github.com/baskerville/bspwm) - Binary space partitioning concepts

1→# Hammerspoon Configuration
     2→
     3→This is a modular Hammerspoon configuration for macOS automation and window management.
     4→
     5→## Structure
     6→
     7→```
     8→~/.hammerspoon/
     9→├── init.lua                    # Main configuration file
    10→├── modules/                    # Modular functionality
    11→│   ├── app-toggle.lua         # Application toggle module
    12→│   ├── media-controls.lua     # Media control module
    13→│   └── window-management.lua  # Window positioning module
    14→└── README.md                  # This file
    15→```
    16→
    17→## Features
    18→
    19→### Application Toggle
    20→
    21→Toggle applications with a single hotkey. If the app isn't running, it launches. If it's focused, it hides. If it's running but not focused, it brings it to front.
    22→
    23→**Current bindings:**
    24→- `Cmd+Space` - Toggle Ghostty terminal
    25→
    26→### Window Management
    27→
    28→Quickly position and resize windows using keyboard shortcuts.
    29→
    30→**Window positioning hotkeys:**
    31→- `Cmd+Option+Left Arrow` - Move window to left half of screen
    32→- `Cmd+Option+Right Arrow` - Move window to right half of screen
    33→- `Cmd+Option+Up Arrow` - Maximize window to full screen
    34→- `Cmd+Option+Down Arrow` - Center window on screen (70% of screen size)
    35→
    36→**Quarter-screen positioning hotkeys:**
    37→- `Cmd+Option+U` - Move window to top-left quarter
    38→- `Cmd+Option+I` - Move window to top-right quarter
    39→- `Cmd+Option+N` - Move window to bottom-left quarter
    40→- `Cmd+Option+M` - Move window to bottom-right quarter
    41→
    42→**Vim-style window focus navigation:**
    43→- `Cmd+Option+K` - Focus window to the left
    44→- `Cmd+Option+O` - Focus window above
    45→- `Cmd+Option+L` - Focus window below
    46→- `Cmd+Option+Ö` - Focus window to the right
    47→
    48→**Window swapping:**
    49→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+K` - Swap focused window with left neighbor
    50→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+O` - Swap focused window with above neighbor
    51→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+L` - Swap focused window with below neighbor
    52→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+Ö` - Swap focused window with right neighbor
    53→
    54→**Multi-display hotkeys:**
    55→- `Cmd+Option+Ctrl+Left Arrow` - Move window to left display
    56→- `Cmd+Option+Ctrl+Right Arrow` - Move window to right display
    57→
    58→### Media Controls
    59→
    60→Control system volume using mouse buttons.
    61→
    62→**Volume control:**
    63→- `Mouse Button 4` (side button) - Increase volume by 5%
    64→- `Mouse Button 5` (side button) - Decrease volume by 5%
    65→
    66→### Configuration Reload
    67→
    68→- `Cmd+Option+Shift+R` - Reload Hammerspoon configuration
    69→
    70→## Usage
    71→
    72→### Adding Application Hotkeys
    73→
    74→To add a new application hotkey, edit `init.lua` and add a line under the "Application Hotkeys" section:
    75→
    76→```lua
    77→appToggle.bindToggle({"cmd", "shift"}, "b", "Safari")
    78→```
    79→
    80→This binds `Cmd+Shift+B` to toggle Safari.
    81→
    82→### Adding Custom Modules
    83→
    84→1. Create a new `.lua` file in the `modules/` directory
    85→2. Define your module as a table with functions
    86→3. Return the module table at the end of the file
    87→4. Load it in `init.lua` with `require("modules.your-module")`
    88→
    89→Example module structure:
    90→
    91→```lua
    92→-- modules/example.lua
    93→local M = {}
    94→
    95→function M.someFunction()
    96→    -- Your code here
    97→end
    98→
    99→return M
   100→```
   101→
   102→Then in `init.lua`:
   103→
   104→```lua
   105→local example = require("modules.example")
   106→example.someFunction()
   107→```
   108→
   109→## Modules
   110→
   111→### app-toggle.lua
   112→
   113→Provides functionality to toggle application visibility.
   114→
   115→**Functions:**
   116→- `createToggle(appName)` - Creates a toggle function for an application
   117→- `bindToggle(modifiers, key, appName)` - Binds a hotkey to toggle an application
   118→
   119→**Example:**
   120→
   121→```lua
   122→local appToggle = require("modules.app-toggle")
   123→
   124→-- Create a toggle function
   125→local toggleSafari = appToggle.createToggle("Safari")
   126→
   127→-- Or bind directly to a hotkey
   128→appToggle.bindToggle({"cmd", "shift"}, "b", "Safari")
   129→```
   130→
   131→### window-management.lua
   132→
   133→Provides window positioning, resizing, and focus navigation functionality.
   134→
   135→**Functions:**
   136→- `moveToLeft()` - Moves focused window to left half of screen
   137→- `moveToRight()` - Moves focused window to right half of screen
   138→- `maximize()` - Maximizes focused window to full screen
   139→- `center()` - Centers focused window at 70% screen size
   140→- `moveToTopLeft()` - Moves focused window to top-left quarter of screen
   141→- `moveToTopRight()` - Moves focused window to top-right quarter of screen
   142→- `moveToBottomLeft()` - Moves focused window to bottom-left quarter of screen
   143→- `moveToBottomRight()` - Moves focused window to bottom-right quarter of screen
   144→- `focusWindowLeft()` - Focuses the window to the left
   145→- `focusWindowDown()` - Focuses the window below
   146→- `focusWindowUp()` - Focuses the window above
   147→- `focusWindowRight()` - Focuses the window to the right
   148→- `swapWindowLeft()` - Swaps focused window with left neighbor
   149→- `swapWindowDown()` - Swaps focused window with below neighbor
   150→- `swapWindowUp()` - Swaps focused window with above neighbor
   151→- `swapWindowRight()` - Swaps focused window with right neighbor
   152→- `moveToLeftDisplay()` - Moves focused window to the display on the left (west)
   153→- `moveToRightDisplay()` - Moves focused window to the display on the right (east)
   154→- `bindHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds all window management functions to arrow keys
   155→- `bindQuarterScreenHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds quarter-screen positioning to U/I/N/M keys
   156→- `bindVimFocusHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds Vim-style focus navigation to K/O/L/Ö keys
   157→- `bindWindowSwapHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds window swapping to K/O/L/Ö keys
   158→- `bindMultiDisplayHotkeys(modifiers)` - Binds multi-display functions to arrow keys
   159→
   160→**Example:**
   161→
   162→```lua
   163→local windowMgmt = require("modules.window-management")
   164→
   165→-- Bind all hotkeys with Cmd+Option
   166→windowMgmt.bindHotkeys({"cmd", "alt"})
   167→
   168→-- Bind quarter-screen hotkeys with Cmd+Option
   169→windowMgmt.bindQuarterScreenHotkeys({"cmd", "alt"})
   170→
   171→-- Bind Vim-style focus navigation with Cmd+Option (K/O/L/Ö)
   172→windowMgmt.bindVimFocusHotkeys({"cmd", "alt"})
   173→
   174→-- Bind window swapping with Cmd+Option+Shift (K/O/L/Ö)
   175→windowMgmt.bindWindowSwapHotkeys({"cmd", "alt", "shift"})
   176→
   177→-- Bind multi-display hotkeys with Cmd+Option+Ctrl
   178→windowMgmt.bindMultiDisplayHotkeys({"cmd", "alt", "ctrl"})
   179→
   180→-- Or call individual functions
   181→windowMgmt.moveToLeft()
   182→windowMgmt.maximize()
   183→windowMgmt.moveToTopLeft()
   184→windowMgmt.focusWindowRight()
   185→windowMgmt.swapWindowLeft()
   186→windowMgmt.moveToLeftDisplay()
   187→```
   188→
   189→### media-controls.lua
   190→
   191→Provides media control functionality including volume control.
   192→
   193→**Functions:**
   194→- `volumeUp()` - Increases system volume by 5%
   195→- `volumeDown()` - Decreases system volume by 5%
   196→- `bindMouseButtons()` - Binds mouse buttons 4 and 5 to volume controls
   197→
   198→**Example:**
   199→
   200→```lua
   201→local mediaControls = require("modules.media-controls")
   202→
   203→-- Bind mouse buttons to volume controls
   204→mediaControls.bindMouseButtons()
   205→
   206→-- Or call volume functions directly
   207→mediaControls.volumeUp()
   208→mediaControls.volumeDown()
   209→```
   210→
   211→## Resources
   212→
   213→- [Hammerspoon Documentation](https://www.hammerspoon.org/docs/)
   214→- [Hammerspoon API Reference](https://www.hammerspoon.org/docs/index.html)
   215→- [Hammerspoon Getting Started](https://www.hammerspoon.org/go/)
   216→
   217→## Notes
   218→
   219→- Configuration changes require a reload to take effect (use `Cmd+Option+Shift+R`)
   220→- Window animations are enabled with a 0.2 second duration (default)
   221→- A notification is shown when the configuration loads successfully
   222→

1→-- app-toggle.lua
     2→-- Module for toggling application visibility with hotkeys
     3→--
     4→-- This module provides functionality to show/hide/launch applications
     5→-- with a single hotkey. If the app is not running, it launches it.
     6→-- If the app is frontmost, it hides it. Otherwise, it brings it to front.
     7→
     8→local M = {}
     9→
    10→--- Creates a toggle function for a specific application
    11→-- @param appName string The name of the application to toggle
    12→-- @return function A function that toggles the specified application
    13→function M.createToggle(appName)
    14→    return function()
    15→        local app = hs.application.get(appName)
    16→
    17→        -- Launch the app if it's not running
    18→        if not app then
    19→            hs.application.launchOrFocus(appName)
    20→            return
    21→        end
    22→
    23→        -- Hide the app if it's currently focused
    24→        if app:isFrontmost() then
    25→            app:hide()
    26→        else
    27→            -- Bring the app to front if it's running but not focused
    28→            app:activate()
    29→        end
    30→    end
    31→end
    32→
    33→--- Binds a hotkey to toggle an application
    34→-- @param modifiers table Array of modifier keys (e.g., {"cmd"}, {"cmd", "shift"})
    35→-- @param key string The key to bind
    36→-- @param appName string The name of the application to toggle
    37→-- @return hotkey The created hotkey object
    38→function M.bindToggle(modifiers, key, appName)
    39→    local toggleFunc = M.createToggle(appName)
    40→    return hs.hotkey.bind(modifiers, key, toggleFunc)
    41→end
    42→
    43→return M
    44→

1→-- window-management.lua
     2→-- Module for window positioning and sizing with hotkeys
     3→
     4→local M = {}
     5→
     6→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
     7→-- Helpers
     8→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
     9→
    10→--- Executes a callback with the focused window and its screen frame
    11→-- @param callback function(win, frame) Called with window and screen frame
    12→local function withWindow(callback)
    13→    local win = hs.window.focusedWindow()
    14→    if not win then return end
    15→    callback(win, win:screen():frame())
    16→end
    17→
    18→--- Moves window to a position defined by ratios of screen dimensions
    19→-- @param xRatio number X position as ratio (0 = left edge, 0.5 = center)
    20→-- @param yRatio number Y position as ratio (0 = top edge, 0.5 = center)
    21→-- @param wRatio number Width as ratio of screen width
    22→-- @param hRatio number Height as ratio of screen height
    23→local function moveToPosition(xRatio, yRatio, wRatio, hRatio)
    24→    withWindow(function(win, frame)
    25→        win:setFrame({
    26→            x = frame.x + (frame.w * xRatio),
    27→            y = frame.y + (frame.h * yRatio),
    28→            w = frame.w * wRatio,
    29→            h = frame.h * hRatio
    30→        })
    31→    end)
    32→end
    33→
    34→--- Generic focus function for directional window focus
    35→-- @param direction string One of: "West", "East", "North", "South"
    36→local function focusDirection(direction)
    37→    withWindow(function(win)
    38→        win["focusWindow" .. direction](win, nil, true, true)
    39→    end)
    40→end
    41→
    42→--- Generic swap function for swapping windows in a direction
    43→-- @param direction string One of: "West", "East", "North", "South"
    44→local function swapDirection(direction)
    45→    withWindow(function(win)
    46→        local targets = win["windowsTo" .. direction](win, nil, true, true)
    47→        local targetWin = targets[1]
    48→        if not targetWin then return end
    49→
    50→        local winFrame = win:frame()
    51→        local targetFrame = targetWin:frame()
    52→        win:setFrame(targetFrame)
    53→        targetWin:setFrame(winFrame)
    54→    end)
    55→end
    56→
    57→--- Moves window to another display
    58→-- @param direction string "West" or "East"
    59→local function moveToDisplay(direction)
    60→    withWindow(function(win)
    61→        local targetScreen = win:screen()["to" .. direction](win:screen())
    62→        if targetScreen then
    63→            win:setFrame(targetScreen:frame())
    64→        end
    65→    end)
    66→end
    67→
    68→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    69→-- Window Positioning
    70→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    71→
    72→function M.moveToLeft()       moveToPosition(0, 0, 0.5, 1) end
    73→function M.moveToRight()      moveToPosition(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) end
    74→function M.maximize()         moveToPosition(0, 0, 1, 1) end
    75→function M.moveToTopLeft()    moveToPosition(0, 0, 0.5, 0.5) end
    76→function M.moveToTopRight()   moveToPosition(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0.5) end
    77→function M.moveToBottomLeft() moveToPosition(0, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end
    78→function M.moveToBottomRight() moveToPosition(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end
    79→
    80→function M.center()
    81→    withWindow(function(win, frame)
    82→        local w, h = frame.w * 0.7, frame.h * 0.7
    83→        win:setFrame({
    84→            x = frame.x + (frame.w - w) / 2,
    85→            y = frame.y + (frame.h - h) / 2,
    86→            w = w, h = h
    87→        })
    88→    end)
    89→end
    90→
    91→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    92→-- Focus Navigation
    93→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94→
    95→function M.focusWindowLeft()  focusDirection("West") end
    96→function M.focusWindowRight() focusDirection("East") end
    97→function M.focusWindowUp()    focusDirection("North") end
    98→function M.focusWindowDown()  focusDirection("South") end
    99→

   102→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   103→
   104→function M.swapWindowLeft()  swapDirection("West") end
   105→function M.swapWindowRight() swapDirection("East") end
   106→function M.swapWindowUp()    swapDirection("North") end
   107→function M.swapWindowDown()  swapDirection("South") end
   108→

   110→-- Multi-Display
   111→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   112→
   113→function M.moveToLeftDisplay()  moveToDisplay("West") end
   114→function M.moveToRightDisplay() moveToDisplay("East") end
   115→
   116→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   117→-- Hotkey Bindings
   118→--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   119→

   121→    hs.hotkey.bind(modifiers, "left", M.moveToLeft)
   122→    hs.hotkey.bind(modifiers, "right", M.moveToRight)
   123→    hs.hotkey.bind(modifiers, "up", M.maximize)

   128→    hs.hotkey.bind(modifiers, "u", M.moveToTopLeft)

   135→    hs.hotkey.bind(modifiers, "k", M.focusWindowLeft)

1→-- media-controls.lua
     2→-- Module for media control with mouse buttons
     3→--
     4→-- This module provides functionality to control system volume and media
     5→-- playback using mouse buttons and keyboard shortcuts.
     6→
     7→local M = {}
     8→
     9→--- Increases system volume using native macOS volume control
    10→function M.volumeUp()
    11→    hs.eventtap.event.newSystemKeyEvent("SOUND_UP", true):post()
    12→    hs.eventtap.event.newSystemKeyEvent("SOUND_UP", false):post()
    13→end
    14→
    15→--- Decreases system volume using native macOS volume control
    16→function M.volumeDown()
    17→    hs.eventtap.event.newSystemKeyEvent("SOUND_DOWN", true):post()
    18→    hs.eventtap.event.newSystemKeyEvent("SOUND_DOWN", false):post()
    19→end
    20→
    21→--- Binds mouse button 4 and 5 to volume controls
    22→-- Mouse button 4: Volume up
    23→-- Mouse button 5: Volume down
    24→function M.bindMouseButtons()
    25→    -- Create an eventtap to watch for mouse button events
    26→    M.mouseButtonTap = hs.eventtap.new({hs.eventtap.event.types.otherMouseDown}, function(event)
    27→        local buttonNumber = event:getProperty(hs.eventtap.event.properties.mouseEventButtonNumber)
    28→
    29→        -- Mouse button 4 (typically back/left side button) = volume down
    30→        if buttonNumber == 3 then  -- Button 4 is index 3 (0-indexed)
    31→            M.volumeDown()
    32→            return true  -- Consume the event
    33→        end
    34→
    35→        -- Mouse button 5 (typically forward/right side button) = volume up
    36→        if buttonNumber == 4 then  -- Button 5 is index 4 (0-indexed)
    37→            M.volumeUp()
    38→            return true  -- Consume the event
    39→        end
    40→
    41→        return false  -- Pass through other mouse buttons
    42→    end)
    43→
    44→    M.mouseButtonTap:start()
    45→    return M.mouseButtonTap
    46→end
    47→
    48→return M
    49→

1→-- url-command.lua
     2→-- Module for running terminal commands with clipboard URL
     3→
     4→local M = {}
     5→
     6→--- Runs a command in Ghostty with the clipboard contents
     7→-- @param commandTemplate string Command template where %s is replaced with clipboard
     8→function M.runInGhostty(commandTemplate)
     9→    local clipboard = hs.pasteboard.getContents() or ""
    10→    local command = string.format(commandTemplate, clipboard)
    11→
    12→    local ghostty = hs.application.find("Ghostty")
    13→
    14→    local function typeAndExecute()
    15→        hs.eventtap.keyStrokes(command)
    16→        hs.eventtap.keyStroke({}, "return")
    17→    end
    18→
    19→    if ghostty then
    20→        ghostty:activate()
    21→        hs.timer.doAfter(0.1, function()
    22→            hs.eventtap.keyStroke({"cmd"}, "t")  -- new tab
    23→            hs.timer.doAfter(0.2, typeAndExecute)
    24→        end)
    25→    else
    26→        hs.application.launchOrFocus("Ghostty")
    27→        hs.timer.doAfter(0.5, typeAndExecute)
    28→    end
    29→end
    30→
    31→--- Binds a hotkey to run a command with clipboard URL
    32→-- @param modifiers table Array of modifier keys
    33→-- @param key string The key to bind
    34→-- @param commandTemplate string Command template (%s = clipboard)
    35→function M.bindHotkey(modifiers, key, commandTemplate)
    36→    hs.hotkey.bind(modifiers, key, function()
    37→        M.runInGhostty(commandTemplate)
    38→    end)
    39→end
    40→
    41→return M
    42→

     6→--- Toggles between two audio output devices
     7→-- @param device1 string Name of first audio device
     8→-- @param device2 string Name of second audio device
     9→function M.toggle(device1, device2)
    10→    local current = hs.audiodevice.defaultOutputDevice():name()
    11→    local next = current == device1 and device2 or device1
    12→    local device = hs.audiodevice.findOutputByName(next)
    13→
    14→    if device then
    15→        device:setDefaultOutputDevice()
    16→        hs.notify.new({title="Audio Output", informativeText=next}):send()
    17→    else
    18→        hs.notify.new({title="Audio Output", informativeText="Device not found: " .. next}):send()
    19→    end
    20→end

    22→--- Binds a hotkey to toggle between two audio devices

    25→-- @param device1 string Name of first audio device
    26→-- @param device2 string Name of second audio device
    27→function M.bindHotkey(modifiers, key, device1, device2)
    28→    hs.hotkey.bind(modifiers, key, function()
    29→        M.toggle(device1, device2)
    30→    end)
    31→end
    32→
    33→return M

## My dotfiles

A set of tools and environment setups I require for work.

This repo should be cloned into `~/Developer/dotfiles` for it to correctly link everything.

## Installation

To run the full installation:

```bash
make install
```

Or manually run:

```bash
sh bootstrap.sh
```

## Available Commands

```bash
make install  # Run full installation
make update   # Update symlinks only
make backup   # Backup existing configs
make ssh      # Setup SSH keys and config
make clean    # Remove symlinks
make help     # Show available commands
```

## What Gets Installed

The installation script will:

### 1. Install Xcode Command Line Tools
Required for development tools and compilers.

### 2. Configure macOS Preferences
Custom system preferences via `osx/osx.sh`.

### 3. Install Homebrew & Applications
The following applications are installed via Homebrew:

**CLI Tools:**
* zsh

**Applications:**
* Alfred
* Hammerspoon
* Stats
* Firefox
* Ghostty
* Proxyman
* RapidAPI
* Sourcetree
* Spotify
* Visual Studio Code
* Xcodes

### 4. Setup Zsh
* Installs Oh My Zsh
* Configures Powerlevel10k theme
* Symlinks `.zshrc` and `.p10k.zsh` to home directory

### 5. Setup Git
* Symlinks `.gitconfig` and `.gitignore_global` to home directory
* Configures global Git settings

### 6. Setup SSH
* Creates SSH directory structure
* Optionally generates SSH keys for Git
* Symlinks SSH config

### 7. Setup Ghostty
* Creates Ghostty config directory
* Symlinks Ghostty configuration to `~/.config/ghostty/config`

### 8. Setup Hammerspoon
* Creates Hammerspoon config directory
* Symlinks Hammerspoon configuration to `~/.hammerspoon/`
* Configures window management, focus modes, and custom shortcuts

## Manual Steps

After installation completes, perform these additional steps:

### SSH Keys

1. If you didn't create an SSH key during installation, run:
   ```bash
   make ssh
   ```

2. Add the public key to your Git providers:
   - **GitHub:** https://github.com/settings/keys
   - **GitLab:** https://gitlab.com/-/profile/keys

   Your public key is displayed at the end of `make ssh`, or run:
   ```bash
   cat ~/.ssh/id_git.pub
   ```

### Xcode

Install full Xcode via Xcodes.app (installed via Homebrew):
```bash
open -a Xcodes
```

### Application Settings

#### Ghostty
1. Open Ghostty
2. Configuration is automatically loaded from `~/.config/ghostty/config`
3. Font and theme settings are pre-configured

#### Hammerspoon
1. Open Hammerspoon
2. Configuration is automatically loaded from `~/.hammerspoon/`
3. Window management shortcuts and focus modes are pre-configured
4. Grant Accessibility permissions when prompted

#### Zsh/Powerlevel10k
If you need to reconfigure the prompt:
```bash
p10k configure
```

## Troubleshooting

### Symlinks not working
Run `make update` to recreate symlinks

### Restore from backup
Backups are stored with timestamps (e.g., `~/.zshrc.backup.20250108_123456`)
```bash
cp ~/.zshrc.backup.YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS ~/.zshrc
```

### Clean install
To remove all symlinks and start fresh:
```bash
make clean
make install
```

# Custom scripts

# Git Cheat Sheet
gh() {
  cat << 'EOF'

➕ ADDING & COMMITTING

# Reset local branch to remote state
gitresetremote() {
  local current_branch=$(git branch --show-current)
  if [[ -z "$current_branch" ]]; then
    echo "Error: Not on a branch"

#!/bin/sh

set -e  # Exit on error
set -u  # Exit on undefined variable

echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  🚀 Dotfiles Installation Starting   ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════╝"

# Backup existing configs
echo "\n💾 [0/8] Backing up existing configs..."
if command -v make >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    make backup 2>/dev/null || echo "⚠️  No existing configs to backup"
else
    # Manual backup if make is not available
    TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
    [ -f ~/.zshrc ] && cp ~/.zshrc ~/.zshrc.backup.$TIMESTAMP && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.zshrc" || true
    [ -f ~/.gitconfig ] && cp ~/.gitconfig ~/.gitconfig.backup.$TIMESTAMP && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.gitconfig" || true
    [ -f ~/.p10k.zsh ] && cp ~/.p10k.zsh ~/.p10k.zsh.backup.$TIMESTAMP && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.p10k.zsh" || true
    [ -f ~/.gitignore_global ] && cp ~/.gitignore_global ~/.gitignore_global.backup.$TIMESTAMP && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.gitignore_global" || true
fi
echo "✅ Backup complete\n"

# Xcode command line tools
echo "🛠️  [1/8] Installing Xcode command line tools..."
if xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "  ⚠️  Xcode command line tools already installed, skipping..."
else
    if xcode-select --install 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  ⏳ Waiting for installation to complete..."
        until xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1; do
            sleep 5
        done
        echo "  ✅ Xcode command line tools installed"
    else
        echo "  ❌ Failed to install Xcode command line tools" >&2
    fi
fi
echo "✅ Xcode setup complete\n"

# OSX preferences
echo "🍎 [2/8] Setting up macOS preferences..."
if sh osx/osx.sh; then
    echo "✅ macOS preferences configured\n"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to configure macOS preferences" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Homebrew 🍺
echo "🍺 [3/8] Setting up Homebrew..."
if sh brew/brew.sh; then
    echo "✅ Homebrew setup complete\n"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to setup Homebrew" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# ZSH
echo "💻 [4/8] Setting up Zsh..."
if sh zsh/zsh.sh; then
    echo "✅ Zsh setup complete\n"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to setup Zsh" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# GIT
echo "📦 [5/8] Setting up Git..."
if sh git/git.sh; then
    echo "✅ Git setup complete\n"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to setup Git" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# SSH
echo "🔐 [6/8] Setting up SSH..."
if sh ssh/ssh.sh; then
    echo "✅ SSH setup complete\n"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to setup SSH" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Ghostty
echo "👻 [7/8] Setting up Ghostty..."
if sh ghostty/ghostty.sh; then
    echo "✅ Ghostty setup complete\n"
else

    exit 1
fi

# Hammerspoon
echo "🔨 [8/8] Setting up Hammerspoon..."
if sh hammerspoon/hammerspoon.sh; then
    echo "✅ Hammerspoon setup complete\n"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to setup Hammerspoon" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  🎉 Installation Complete! 🎉        ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo "\n📝 Please complete the manual steps listed in README.md"
echo "✨ Happy coding! ✨\n"

#!/bin/sh

set -e  # Exit on error
set -u  # Exit on undefined variable

print_success() {
    printf "\e[0;32m  [✔] $1\n\e[0m"
}

if ! command -v defaults >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "defaults command not found; skipping macOS preferences."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Setting up macOS preferences..."

# Scroll direction natural : False
defaults write -g com.apple.swipescrolldirection -bool false
print_success "Scroll direction natural (Lion style) set to false."

# Automatically hide and show the Dock
defaults write com.apple.dock autohide -bool true
print_success "Automatically hide and show the Dock."

# Display full path in Finder title window
defaults write com.apple.finder _FXShowPosixPathInTitle -bool true
print_success "Finder shows full path in title."

# Check for software updates daily, not just once per week
defaults write com.apple.SoftwareUpdate ScheduleFrequency -int 1
print_success "Software updates checking daily"

# Trackpad: enable tap to click for this user and for the login screen
defaults write com.apple.driver.AppleBluetoothMultitouch.trackpad Clicking -bool true
defaults -currentHost write NSGlobalDomain com.apple.mouse.tapBehavior -int 1
defaults write NSGlobalDomain com.apple.mouse.tapBehavior -int 1
print_success "Tap to click enabled at the trackpad"

# Automatically quit printer app once the print jobs complete
defaults write com.apple.print.PrintingPrefs "Quit When Finished" -bool true
print_success "Printer app quit once the prints complete."

# Disable the "Are you sure you want to open this application?" dialog
defaults write com.apple.LaunchServices LSQuarantine -bool false
print_success "Are you sure you want to open this app dialog disabled."

echo "Restarting affected services..."
killall Dock >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
killall Finder >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
killall SystemUIServer >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo "macOS preferences setup complete!"

# Dotfiles Review & Improvement Suggestions

## Overall Assessment

This is a well-structured, clean dotfiles repo. The modular organization, automated bootstrap, backup system, and Hammerspoon setup are all solid. Below are concrete improvement suggestions organized by priority.

---

## Issues to Fix

### 1. `gh()` function shadows the GitHub CLI
- **File:** `zsh/.zshrc:27`
- The `gh()` function overrides the `github-cli` command (`gh`), which is a widely-used tool. Even if you don't use it today, it's a footgun.
- **Fix:** Rename to `githelp()` or `gcheat()`.

### 2. `go` alias shadows the Go programming language binary
- **File:** `zsh/.zshrc:24`
- `alias go=...` will break Go development if you ever use it.
- **Fix:** Rename to `gameon` or `gon`.

### 3. Hardcoded absolute paths in `.gitconfig`
- **File:** `git/.gitconfig:5,14`
- `excludesfile = /Users/brunobrunkow/...` and `template = /Users/brunobrunkow/...` — these break portability and will fail on any other machine or username.
- **Fix:** Use `~/.gitignore_global` and `~/.stCommitMsg` (git expands `~`), or set them dynamically in `git.sh` via `git config --global`.

### 4. Commit template references a missing file
- **File:** `git/.gitconfig:14`
- `template = /Users/brunobrunkow/.stCommitMsg` — this file doesn't exist in the repo and isn't created by any setup script. Either include it or remove the line.

### 5. `make clean` doesn't remove Ghostty config symlink
- **File:** `Makefile:42-47`
- `clean` target removes zsh, git, and hammerspoon symlinks but forgets `~/.config/ghostty/config`.
- **Fix:** Add `@rm -f ~/.config/ghostty/config`.

### 6. `make backup` doesn't back up Ghostty or Hammerspoon configs
- **File:** `Makefile:29-34`
- Backup only covers zsh, git, p10k, and gitignore_global. Missing: Ghostty config, Hammerspoon config, SSH config.

### 7. `make update` re-runs full setup scripts (not just symlinks)
- **File:** `Makefile:22-25`
- It runs `zsh.sh`, which re-installs oh-my-zsh, fonts, plugins, etc. — not just symlink updates. Either rename the target or create lightweight symlink-only scripts.

### 8. Deprecated Homebrew tap
- **File:** `brew/Brewfile:1`
- `tap "homebrew/bundle"` is no longer needed — `brew bundle` is built-in since Homebrew 4.x. This generates a warning.
- **Fix:** Remove the line.

---

## Improvements to Consider

### 9. Git config: add useful modern defaults
- **File:** `git/.gitconfig`
- Add commonly recommended settings:
  - `[init] defaultBranch = main`
  - `[pull] rebase = true` (cleaner history)
  - `[diff] algorithm = histogram` (better diffs)
  - `[merge] conflictstyle = zdiff3` (better conflict markers)
  - `[rerere] enabled = true` (remember conflict resolutions)

### 10. Add more CLI tools to Brewfile
- **File:** `brew/Brewfile`
- You only install `zsh` as a CLI tool. Consider adding tools you likely already use:
  - `git` (Homebrew version is newer than macOS default)
  - `yt-dlp` (your Hammerspoon config depends on it)
  - `coreutils`, `jq`, `ripgrep`, `fd`, `fzf`, `bat`, `eza` — common dev essentials
  - `mas` — Mac App Store CLI (for apps not in Homebrew)

### 11. PostgreSQL path is hardcoded to v13
- **File:** `zsh/.zshrc:11`
- `/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@13/bin` — if you upgrade Postgres, you'll forget to update this. Consider removing it from `.zshrc` and relying on `brew link` or adding it conditionally.

### 12. Add Ghostty and SSH config to `.gitignore_global` exclusion / backup / clean cycle
- Ghostty config is set up but not backed up or cleaned. SSH config is set up but not backed up.

### 13. Shell scripts use `/bin/sh` but some use zsh-isms
- **File:** `bootstrap.sh:1`
- `echo "\n..."` is a zsh/bash-ism that doesn't work in POSIX `sh` on all systems. Consider switching shebangs to `#!/bin/bash` or using `printf` instead.

### 14. Consider XDG base directory conventions
- Configs are symlinked to `~/` (`.zshrc`, `.gitconfig`, etc.) which is standard, but for newer tools you could consolidate under `~/.config/` for tidiness. Ghostty already does this — git supports it too via `~/.config/git/config`.

### 15. README accuracy
- The README is accurate and well-written. One minor issue: it says "8 steps" but bootstrap.sh actually has steps 0-8 (9 steps including backup). The numbering in the README (1-8) matches the bootstrap labels though, so this is fine.

---

## Nice-to-Haves (Low Priority)

### 16. Add a `make test` or `make lint` target
- Run `shellcheck` on all `.sh` files to catch POSIX compliance issues and bugs.

### 17. Hammerspoon auto-reload on config change
- Instead of manual `Cmd+Alt+Shift+R`, add a pathwatcher in `init.lua` that auto-reloads when files in `~/.hammerspoon/` change.

### 18. Add `1Password SSH agent` or similar
- Instead of managing SSH keys manually, consider 1Password or secretive for hardware-backed SSH keys.

---

## Verification

After making changes:
1. Run `make clean && make install` on a test account or VM
2. Verify all symlinks point correctly: `ls -la ~/.zshrc ~/.gitconfig ~/.p10k.zsh ~/.config/ghostty/config`
3. Open a new terminal — confirm prompt loads, aliases work, `gh` (GitHub CLI) is not shadowed
4. Run `shellcheck bootstrap.sh osx/osx.sh brew/brew.sh git/git.sh zsh/zsh.sh ssh/ssh.sh ghostty/ghostty.sh hammerspoon/hammerspoon.sh` for lint issues

- **File:** `git/.gitconfig:5,14`
- `excludesfile = /Users/brunobrunkow/...` and `template = /Users/brunobrunkow/...` — these break portability and will fail on any other machine or username.

- **File:** `git/.gitconfig:14`
- `template = /Users/brunobrunkow/.stCommitMsg` — this file doesn't exist in the repo and isn't created by any setup script. Either include it or remove the line.

- **File:** `Makefile:42-47`
- `clean` target removes zsh, git, and hammerspoon symlinks but forgets `~/.config/ghostty/config`.

- **File:** `Makefile:29-34`

- **File:** `Makefile:22-25`
- It runs `zsh.sh`, which re-installs oh-my-zsh, fonts, plugins, etc. — not just symlink updates. Either rename the target or create lightweight symlink-only scripts.

- **File:** `brew/Brewfile:1`
- `tap "homebrew/bundle"` is no longer needed — `brew bundle` is built-in since Homebrew 4.x. This generates a warning.
- **Fix:** Remove the line.

- **File:** `git/.gitconfig`

  - `[init] defaultBranch = main`
  - `[pull] rebase = true` (cleaner history)

---

- Run `shellcheck` on all `.sh` files to catch POSIX compliance issues and bugs.

### 17. Hammerspoon auto-reload on config change
- Instead of manual `Cmd+Alt+Shift+R`, add a pathwatcher in `init.lua` that auto-reloads when files in `~/.hammerspoon/` change.

### 18. Add `1Password SSH agent` or similar
- Instead of managing SSH keys manually, consider 1Password or secretive for hardware-backed SSH keys.

---

## Verification

After making changes:
1. Run `make clean && make install` on a test account or VM

3. Open a new terminal — confirm prompt loads, aliases work, `gh` (GitHub CLI) is not shadowed
4. Run `shellcheck bootstrap.sh osx/osx.sh brew/brew.sh git/git.sh zsh/zsh.sh ssh/ssh.sh ghostty/ghostty.sh hammerspoon/hammerspoon.sh` for lint issues

- The `gh()` function overrides the `github-cli` command (`gh`), which is a widely-used tool. Even if you don't use it today, it's a footgun.
- **Fix:** Rename to `githelp()` or `gcheat()`.

### 2. `go` alias shadows the Go programming language binary
- **File:** `zsh/.zshrc:24`
- `alias go=...` will break Go development if you ever use it.
- **Fix:** Rename to `gameon` or `gon`.

### 3. Hardcoded absolute paths in `.gitconfig`
- **File:** `git/.gitconfig:5,14`
- `excludesfile = /Users/brunobrunkow/...` and `template = /Users/brunobrunkow/...` — these break portability and will fail on any other machine or username.
- **Fix:** Use `~/.gitignore_global` and `~/.stCommitMsg` (git expands `~`), or set them dynamically in `git.sh` via `git config --global`.

### 4. Commit template references a missing file
- **File:** `git/.gitconfig:14`
- `template = /Users/brunobrunkow/.stCommitMsg` — this file doesn't exist in the repo and isn't created by any setup script. Either include it or remove the line.

### 5. `make clean` doesn't remove Ghostty config symlink
- **File:** `Makefile:42-47`
- `clean` target removes zsh, git, and hammerspoon symlinks but forgets `~/.config/ghostty/config`.
- **Fix:** Add `@rm -f ~/.config/ghostty/config`.

### 6. `make backup` doesn't back up Ghostty or Hammerspoon configs
- **File:** `Makefile:29-34`
- Backup only covers zsh, git, p10k, and gitignore_global. Missing: Ghostty config, Hammerspoon config, SSH config.

### 7. `make update` re-runs full setup scripts (not just symlinks)
- **File:** `Makefile:22-25`
- It runs `zsh.sh`, which re-installs oh-my-zsh, fonts, plugins, etc. — not just symlink updates. Either rename the target or create lightweight symlink-only scripts.

### 8. Deprecated Homebrew tap
- **File:** `brew/Brewfile:1`
- `tap "homebrew/bundle"` is no longer needed — `brew bundle` is built-in since Homebrew 4.x. This generates a warning.
- **Fix:** Remove the line.

---

## Improvements to Consider

### 9. Git config: add useful modern defaults
- **File:** `git/.gitconfig`
- Add commonly recommended settings:
  - `[init] defaultBranch = main`
  - `[pull] rebase = true` (cleaner history)
  - `[diff] algorithm = histogram` (better diffs)
  - `[merge] conflictstyle = zdiff3` (better conflict markers)
  - `[rerere] enabled = true` (remember conflict resolutions)

### 10. Add more CLI tools to Brewfile
- **File:** `brew/Brewfile`
- You only install `zsh` as a CLI tool. Consider adding tools you likely already use:
  - `git` (Homebrew version is newer than macOS default)
  - `yt-dlp` (your Hammerspoon config depends on it)
  - `coreutils`, `jq`, `ripgrep`, `fd`, `fzf`, `bat`, `eza` — common dev essentials
  - `mas` — Mac App Store CLI (for apps not in Homebrew)

### 11. PostgreSQL path is hardcoded to v13
- **File:** `zsh/.zshrc:11`
- `/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@13/bin` — if you upgrade Postgres, you'll forget to update this. Consider removing it from `.zshrc` and relying on `brew link` or adding it conditionally.

### 12. Add Ghostty and SSH config to `.gitignore_global` exclusion / backup / clean cycle
- Ghostty config is set up but not backed up or cleaned. SSH config is set up but not backed up.

### 13. Shell scripts use `/bin/sh` but some use zsh-isms
- **File:** `bootstrap.sh:1`
- `echo "\n..."` is a zsh/bash-ism that doesn't work in POSIX `sh` on all systems. Consider switching shebangs to `#!/bin/bash` or using `printf` instead.

### 14. Consider XDG base directory conventions
- Configs are symlinked to `~/` (`.zshrc`, `.gitconfig`, etc.) which is standard, but for newer tools you could consolidate under `~/.config/` for tidiness. Ghostty already does this — git supports it too via `~/.config/git/config`.

### 15. README accuracy
- The README is accurate and well-written. One minor issue: it says "8 steps" but bootstrap.sh actually has steps 0-8 (9 steps including backup). The numbering in the README (1-8) matches the bootstrap labels though, so this is fine.

---

## Nice-to-Haves (Low Priority)

### 16. Add a `make test` or `make lint` target
- Run `shellcheck` on all `.sh` files to catch POSIX compliance issues and bugs.

### 17. Hammerspoon auto-reload on config change
- Instead of manual `Cmd+Alt+Shift+R`, add a pathwatcher in `init.lua` that auto-reloads when files in `~/.hammerspoon/` change.

### 18. Add `1Password SSH agent` or similar
- Instead of managing SSH keys manually, consider 1Password or secretive for hardware-backed SSH keys.

---

Implementing: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, 15, 17

Skipping: 10 (Brewfile CLI tools), 11 (PostgreSQL path), 14 (XDG conventions), 16 (make lint), 18 (1Password SSH)

After making changes:
1. Run `make clean && make install` on a test account or VM

-- ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua
-- Hammerspoon Configuration

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Configuration
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

hs.window.animationDuration = 0.2
hs.notify.new({title="Hammerspoon", informativeText="Config loaded"}):send()

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Load Modules
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local appToggle = require("modules.app-toggle")
local windowMgmt = require("modules.window-management")
local mediaControls = require("modules.media-controls")
local urlCommand = require("modules.url-command")
local audioToggle = require("modules.audio-toggle")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Application Hotkeys
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Cmd+Space: Toggle Ghostty terminal
appToggle.bindToggle({"cmd"}, "space", "Ghostty")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Window Management Hotkeys
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local winMod = {"cmd", "alt"}

-- Arrow keys: half-screen positioning + maximize + center
windowMgmt.bindHotkeys(winMod)

-- U/I/N/M: quarter-screen positioning
windowMgmt.bindQuarterScreenHotkeys(winMod)

-- K/O/L/Ö: vim-style focus navigation
windowMgmt.bindVimFocusHotkeys(winMod)

-- Ctrl+Arrow: move window between displays
windowMgmt.bindMultiDisplayHotkeys({"cmd", "alt", "ctrl"})

-- Shift+K/O/L/Ö: swap windows
windowMgmt.bindWindowSwapHotkeys({"cmd", "alt", "shift"})

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Media Controls
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Mouse buttons 4/5: volume control
mediaControls.bindMouseButtons()

-- Cmd+Shift+A: Toggle audio output device
audioToggle.bindHotkey({"cmd", "shift"}, "A", "MacBook Air-Lautsprecher", "KT USB Audio")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- URL Commands
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Cmd+Shift+U: Download audio from clipboard URL
-- Add `--cookies-from-browser firefox` if needed for certain sites
urlCommand.bindHotkey({"cmd", "shift"}, "U",
    "cd ~/Downloads && yt-dlp -x --audio-format mp3 --audio-quality 0 --embed-thumbnail --embed-metadata -o '%%(album)s/%%(playlist_index&{:02d}. |)s%%(title)s.%%(ext)s' %s")

-- Cmd+Shift+V: Download video from clipboard URL
urlCommand.bindHotkey({"cmd", "shift"}, "V",
    "cd ~/Downloads && yt-dlp --cookies-from-browser firefox -o '%%(title)s.%%(ext)s' %s")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- System Hotkeys
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Ctrl+Option+Cmd+B: Sleep Mac
hs.hotkey.bind({"ctrl", "alt", "cmd"}, "B", hs.caffeinate.systemSleep)

-- Cmd+Option+Shift+R: Reload config
hs.hotkey.bind({"cmd", "alt", "shift"}, "R", hs.reload)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Initialization Complete
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

print("Hammerspoon configuration loaded successfully")

#!/bin/sh

set -e  # Exit on error
set -u  # Exit on undefined variable

DOTFILES_DIR="$HOME/Developer/dotfiles"

# Check if Homebrew already installed
if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "  ⚠️  Homebrew already installed, skipping installation..."
else
    echo "  📥 Installing Homebrew..."
    if /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/master/install.sh)"; then
        echo "  ✅ Homebrew installed"
    else
        echo "  ❌ Failed to install Homebrew" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Resolve Homebrew path for both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
BREW_BIN="$(command -v brew || true)"
if [ -z "$BREW_BIN" ]; then
    if [ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/brew ]; then
        BREW_BIN=/opt/homebrew/bin/brew
    elif [ -x /usr/local/bin/brew ]; then
        BREW_BIN=/usr/local/bin/brew
    fi
fi

if [ -z "$BREW_BIN" ]; then
    echo "  ❌ Homebrew binary not found after install" >&2
    exit 1
fi

BREW_SHELLENV_LINE="eval \"\$($BREW_BIN shellenv)\""

# Only add to .zprofile if not already there
if ! grep -q "brew shellenv" ~/.zprofile 2>/dev/null; then
    echo '# Set PATH, MANPATH, etc., for Homebrew.' >> ~/.zprofile
    echo "$BREW_SHELLENV_LINE" >> ~/.zprofile
    echo "  ✅ Added Homebrew to .zprofile"
else
    echo "  ⚠️  Homebrew already configured in .zprofile"
fi

eval "$($BREW_BIN shellenv)"

echo "  📦 Installing packages from Brewfile..."
if brew bundle --file "$DOTFILES_DIR/brew/Brewfile"; then
    echo "  ✅ Brew packages installed"
else
    echo "  ❌ Failed to install brew packages" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "🎉 Homebrew setup complete!"

#!/bin/sh

set -e  # Exit on error
set -u  # Exit on undefined variable

DOTFILES_DIR="$HOME/Developer/dotfiles"

echo "💻 Setting up Zsh..."

# oh-my-zsh
if [ -d ~/.oh-my-zsh ]; then
    echo "  ⚠️  oh-my-zsh already installed, skipping..."
else
    echo "  📥 Installing oh-my-zsh..."
    if sh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/master/tools/install.sh)"; then
        echo "  ✅ oh-my-zsh installed"
    else
        echo "  ❌ Failed to install oh-my-zsh" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# download fonts
echo "  🔤 Downloading Powerline fonts..."
cd ~/Library/Fonts || exit 1
for font in "Regular" "Bold" "Italic" "Bold%20Italic"; do
    font_file="MesloLGS NF ${font}.ttf"
    font_file_clean=$(echo "$font_file" | sed 's/%20/ /g')
    if [ -f "$font_file_clean" ]; then
        echo "    ⚠️  Font $font_file_clean already exists, skipping..."
    else
        curl -O "https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k-media/raw/master/MesloLGS%20NF%20${font}.ttf"
    fi
done
echo "  ✅ Fonts downloaded"

# themes and plugins
POWERLEVEL10K_DIR="${ZSH_CUSTOM:-$HOME/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/themes/powerlevel10k"
if [ -d "$POWERLEVEL10K_DIR" ]; then
    echo "  ⚠️  Powerlevel10k already installed, skipping..."
else
    echo "  🎨 Installing Powerlevel10k theme..."
    if git clone https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k.git "$POWERLEVEL10K_DIR"; then
        echo "  ✅ Powerlevel10k installed"
    else
        echo "  ❌ Failed to install Powerlevel10k" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

ZSH_AUTOSUGGESTIONS_DIR="${ZSH_CUSTOM:-$HOME/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/plugins/zsh-autosuggestions"
if [ -d "$ZSH_AUTOSUGGESTIONS_DIR" ]; then
    echo "  ⚠️  zsh-autosuggestions already installed, skipping..."
else
    echo "  🔌 Installing zsh-autosuggestions plugin..."
    if git clone https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions.git "$ZSH_AUTOSUGGESTIONS_DIR"; then
        echo "  ✅ zsh-autosuggestions installed"
    else
        echo "  ❌ Failed to install zsh-autosuggestions" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

FAST_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHTING_DIR="${ZSH_CUSTOM:-$HOME/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/plugins/fast-syntax-highlighting"
if [ -d "$FAST_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHTING_DIR" ]; then
    echo "  ⚠️  fast-syntax-highlighting already installed, skipping..."
else
    echo "  🔌 Installing fast-syntax-highlighting plugin..."
    if git clone https://github.com/zdharma-continuum/fast-syntax-highlighting.git "$FAST_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHTING_DIR"; then
        echo "  ✅ fast-syntax-highlighting installed"
    else
        echo "  ❌ Failed to install fast-syntax-highlighting" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

ZSH_AUTOCOMPLETE_DIR="${ZSH_CUSTOM:-$HOME/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/plugins/zsh-autocomplete"
if [ -d "$ZSH_AUTOCOMPLETE_DIR" ]; then
    echo "  ⚠️  zsh-autocomplete already installed, skipping..."
else
    echo "  🔌 Installing zsh-autocomplete plugin..."
    if git clone https://github.com/marlonrichert/zsh-autocomplete.git "$ZSH_AUTOCOMPLETE_DIR"; then
        echo "  ✅ zsh-autocomplete installed"
    else
        echo "  ❌ Failed to install zsh-autocomplete" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

#!/bin/bash

set -e  # Exit on error
set -u  # Exit on undefined variable

echo "🔐 Setting up SSH configuration..."

SSH_KEY_PATH="$HOME/.ssh/id_git"
SSH_CONFIG_PATH="$HOME/.ssh/config"

# Ensure .ssh directory exists with correct permissions
if [ ! -d "$HOME/.ssh" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh"
    chmod 700 "$HOME/.ssh"
    echo "  ✅ Created .ssh directory"
fi

# Check if SSH key exists
if [ -f "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
    echo "  ✅ SSH key already exists at $SSH_KEY_PATH"
else
    echo ""
    echo "  🔑 SSH key not found. You can create one with:"
    echo "     ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C 'your_email@example.com' -f $SSH_KEY_PATH"
    echo ""
    read -p "  Would you like to create an SSH key now? (y/n) " -n 1 -r
    echo
    if [[ $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
        read -r -p "  Enter your email address: " email
        if ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "$email" -f "$SSH_KEY_PATH"; then
            echo "  ✅ SSH key created at $SSH_KEY_PATH"
        else
            echo "  ❌ Failed to create SSH key" >&2
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "  ⚠️  Skipping SSH key creation"
        echo "  ⚠️  Remember to create it manually later"
    fi
fi

# Create or update SSH config
if [ ! -f "$SSH_CONFIG_PATH" ]; then
    cat > "$SSH_CONFIG_PATH" << 'EOF'
Host *
    AddKeysToAgent yes
    UseKeychain yes
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_git
EOF
    chmod 600 "$SSH_CONFIG_PATH"
    echo "  ✅ Created SSH config at $SSH_CONFIG_PATH"
else
    echo "  ⚠️  SSH config already exists at $SSH_CONFIG_PATH"
fi

# Add key to ssh-agent if it exists
if [ -f "$SSH_KEY_PATH" ]; then
    # Start ssh-agent if not running
    if ! pgrep -u "$USER" ssh-agent > /dev/null; then
        eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" > /dev/null
        echo "  ✅ Started ssh-agent"
    fi

    # Add key to agent
    if ssh-add -l 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$SSH_KEY_PATH"; then
        echo "  ✅ SSH key already added to agent"
    else
        if ssh-add "$SSH_KEY_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "  ✅ SSH key added to agent"
        else
            echo "  ⚠️  SSH key could not be added to agent (may require passphrase)"
        fi
    fi

    # Display public key for easy copying
    if [ -f "$SSH_KEY_PATH.pub" ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "  🔑 Your public SSH key (add this to GitHub/GitLab):"
        echo "  ╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
        cat "$SSH_KEY_PATH.pub"
        echo "  ╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
        echo ""
    fi
fi

echo "🎉 SSH configuration complete!"

set -e  # Exit on error
set -u  # Exit on undefined variable

DOTFILES_DIR="$HOME/Developer/dotfiles"

echo "✨ Setting up Hammerspoon..."

# Remove existing .hammerspoon directory or symlink

fi

    # Manual backup if make is not available

    [ -f ~/.zshrc ] && cp ~/.zshrc ~/.zshrc.backup.$TIMESTAMP && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.zshrc" || true

## My dotfiles

A set of tools and environment setups I require for work.

This repo should be cloned into `~/Developer/dotfiles` for it to correctly link everything.

## Installation

To run the full installation:

```bash
make install
```

Or manually run:

```bash
sh bootstrap.sh
```

## Available Commands

```bash
make install  # Run full installation
make update   # Update symlinks only
make backup   # Backup existing configs
make ssh      # Setup SSH keys and config
make clean    # Remove symlinks
make help     # Show available commands
```

## What Gets Installed

The installation script will:

### 1. Install Xcode Command Line Tools
Required for development tools and compilers.

### 2. Configure macOS Preferences
Custom system preferences via `osx/osx.sh`.

### 3. Install Homebrew & Applications
The following applications are installed via Homebrew:

**CLI Tools:**
* zsh

**Applications:**
* Alfred
* Hammerspoon
* Stats
* Firefox
* Ghostty
* Proxyman
* RapidAPI
* Sourcetree
* Spotify
* Visual Studio Code
* Xcodes

### 4. Setup Zsh
* Installs Oh My Zsh
* Configures Powerlevel10k theme
* Symlinks `.zshrc` and `.p10k.zsh` to home directory

### 5. Setup Git
* Symlinks `.gitconfig` and `.gitignore_global` to home directory
* Configures global Git settings

### 6. Setup SSH
* Creates SSH directory structure
* Optionally generates SSH keys for Git
* Symlinks SSH config

### 7. Setup Ghostty
* Creates Ghostty config directory
* Symlinks Ghostty configuration to `~/.config/ghostty/config`

### 8. Setup Hammerspoon
* Creates Hammerspoon config directory
* Symlinks Hammerspoon configuration to `~/.hammerspoon/`
* Configures window management, focus modes, and custom shortcuts

## Manual Steps

After installation completes, perform these additional steps:

### SSH Keys

1. If you didn't create an SSH key during installation, run:
   ```bash
   make ssh
   ```

2. Add the public key to your Git providers:
   - **GitHub:** https://github.com/settings/keys
   - **GitLab:** https://gitlab.com/-/profile/keys

   Your public key is displayed at the end of `make ssh`, or run:
   ```bash
   cat ~/.ssh/id_git.pub
   ```

### Xcode

Install full Xcode via Xcodes.app (installed via Homebrew):
```bash
open -a Xcodes
```

### Application Settings

#### Ghostty
1. Open Ghostty
2. Configuration is automatically loaded from `~/.config/ghostty/config`
3. Font and theme settings are pre-configured

#### Hammerspoon
1. Open Hammerspoon
2. Configuration is automatically loaded from `~/.hammerspoon/`
3. Window management shortcuts and focus modes are pre-configured
4. Grant Accessibility permissions when prompted

#### Zsh/Powerlevel10k
If you need to reconfigure the prompt:
```bash
p10k configure
```

## Troubleshooting

### Symlinks not working
Run `make update` to recreate symlinks

### Restore from backup
Backups are stored with timestamps (e.g., `~/.zshrc.backup.20250108_123456`)
```bash
cp ~/.zshrc.backup.YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS ~/.zshrc
```

### Clean install
To remove all symlinks and start fresh:
```bash
make clean
make install
```

# Git Cheat Sheet

  cat << 'EOF'

# Reset local branch to remote state
gitresetremote() {
  local current_branch=$(git branch --show-current)
  if [[ -z "$current_branch" ]]; then
    echo "Error: Not on a branch"
    return 1
  fi

  read -q "REPLY?Continue? (y/n) "

  [[ $REPLY == "y" ]] || return 0
  
  git reset --hard origin/$current_branch && \
    echo "✓ Reset to origin/$current_branch"

#!/bin/bash

set -e  # Exit on error
set -u  # Exit on undefined variable

echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║  🚀 Dotfiles Installation Starting   ║"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════╝"

# Backup existing configs
echo "\n💾 [0/8] Backing up existing configs..."
if command -v make >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    make backup 2>/dev/null || echo "⚠️  No existing configs to backup"
else
    # Manual backup if make is not available
    TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
    [ -f ~/.zshrc ] && cp ~/.zshrc ~/.zshrc.backup.$TIMESTAMP && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.zshrc" || true
    [ -f ~/.gitconfig ] && cp ~/.gitconfig ~/.gitconfig.backup.$TIMESTAMP && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.gitconfig" || true
    [ -f ~/.p10k.zsh ] && cp ~/.p10k.zsh ~/.p10k.zsh.backup.$TIMESTAMP && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.p10k.zsh" || true
    [ -f ~/.gitignore_global ] && cp ~/.gitignore_global ~/.gitignore_global.backup.$TIMESTAMP && echo "  ✅ Backed up ~/.gitignore_global" || true
fi
echo "✅ Backup complete\n"

# Xcode command line tools
echo "🛠️  [1/8] Installing Xcode command line tools..."
if xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "  ⚠️  Xcode command line tools already installed, skipping..."
else
    if xcode-select --install 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  ⏳ Waiting for installation to complete..."
        until xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1; do
            sleep 5
        done
        echo "  ✅ Xcode command line tools installed"
    else
        echo "  ❌ Failed to install Xcode command line tools" >&2
    fi
fi
echo "✅ Xcode setup complete\n"

else

    exit 1
fi

# SSH

if sh ssh/ssh.sh; then
    echo "✅ SSH setup complete\n"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to setup SSH" >&2
    exit 1

if sh ghostty/ghostty.sh; then

    echo "❌ Failed to setup Ghostty" >&2

    echo "❌ Failed to setup Hammerspoon" >&2
    exit 1

echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════╗"

echo "\n📝 Please complete the manual steps listed in README.md"
